info.title: Replay Crate API
info.description: Records every Spotify play, counts plays per track, manages playlists and serves listening metrics. Every error is JSON `{ error: <code>, ...details }`, and every response carries `X-Request-Id`.

post.description: Called by a hosted scheduler (GitHub Actions, once deployed). Authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`, not a user session.
Exchanges the PKCE authorization code for tokens, stores them encrypted, and starts a session (sets the `rc_session` cookie).
Ends the session, if there is one, and clears the cookie.

Records the user's recently played tracks. Within 30 s of the last sync it returns `skipped` without calling Spotify. `missedPlays` means more than Spotify's last 50 plays happened since the previous sync, so there is a gap (see `/history/gaps`).

get.description: Unfilled stretches where plays may be missing, newest first. An import fills them.

Newest first. Two ways to page: pass `nextCursor` back as `before` for the next page (infinite scroll), or pass `offset` for numbered pages, which also returns `total` and `olderPlayedAt`. Not both at once.

get.description: With play counts, last plays and ratings. `plays`, `last_played` and `rating` sort highest and newest first (unrated tracks last), `name` A–Z. `minRating` keeps only tracks rated that many stars or more. post.description: Step 1 of 3. The browser parses the Extended Streaming History export and uploads only timestamp, play time and track id: create, add plays (in chunks), finish.
Step 2 of 3. Up to 5000 plays per request; call as often as needed.
Step 3 of 3. Plays of known tracks move into the history now; unknown tracks are queued for lookup and their plays follow. Closes any history gap the import covers.

get.description: Tracks from all of Spotify, for finding music you have never played. Only the free text of `q` is sent (filters are for your library), and Spotify returns at most 10. Separate from /search, so Spotify's latency or rate limits never hold up your library's results.

Tracks, artists, albums, playlists and plays in your library, grouped by type, as you type. `q` is free text (typo-tolerant, matched at word starts) plus filters: `artist:` `album:` `in:` (playlist) `from:` (played from) `rating:` `plays:` `year:` `type:`, with comparisons (`rating:>=4`), ranges (`year:1990..1995`), decades (`year:90s`), quotes, and `-` to exclude. Ranked by match, then your plays and ratings.
